sentences.text: Welcommia is an extinct genus of shark belonging to the class Chondrichthyes.
Three species have been described from Late Jurassic fossils in France, Germany, and Belgium.
Welcommia bodeuri serves as the type species, meaning it is the species the genus is based on.
The genus is classified within the family Pseudonotidanidae.
These sharks lived during the Valanginian stage of the Jurassic period, between 137.05 and 132.6 million years ago.
